title: How Do Generative Models Draw a Software Engineer? A Case Study on Stable Diffusion Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Generates images using prompts with and without the 'Software Engineer' keyword, uses the BLIP Vision-Question-Answering model to classify the depicted figures as Male or Female, and calculates the absolute difference in percentage between male and female images (Statistical Parity).

Generates images using prompts with and without the 'Software Engineer' keyword, uses the BLIP Vision-Question-Answering model to classify the depicted figures into five main ethnicity categories (Arab, Asian, Black, White, Other), and calculates the absolute difference between the maximum and minimum percentages of images showing a specific ethnicity category.
